import_csv.title: Import events from CSV
import_csv.description:
Columns: name, type, day, month, year (optional, required for one_time), icon (optional), vip (optional), last_name (optional). `type` must be one of: birthday, anniversary, name_day, wedding_anniversary, memorial, pet_birthday, work_anniversary, custom, one_time (always in English, regardless of your language setting). `vip` accepts 1/true/yes/y/x (case-insensitive); leave it empty or omit the column for a non-VIP event. Keep every column even when a value is empty - a row with a missing trailing comma shifts the following values left. Invalid rows are skipped and logged.

Example:
```
name,type,day,month,year,icon,vip,last_name
Anna,birthday,12,4,1988,,,Miller
Max,pet_birthday,3,9,2020,mdi:dog,,
Test Custom,custom,1,1,,mdi:test-tube,1,
Family Vacation,one_time,15,7,2026,mdi:airplane,,
```

import_ics.title: Import events from ICS calendar
import_ics.description: Upload an .ics calendar file - typically an exported calendar. Only all-day, non-recurring-override entries are read; timed events are skipped. The next steps let you review and correct the proposed name split (and swap first/last name for everyone at once) before anything is imported.

import_vcard_menu.title: Import events from vCard
import_vcard_menu.description: A contact's birthday and its other dates (anniversaries, custom dates) go through separate branches, since only birthdays share a single event type for the whole batch - every other date is assigned its own type during review.

import_vcard.title: Import birthdays from vCard
import_vcard.description: Upload a .vcf file - typically exported contacts. Only entries with a birthday set are read. First/last name comes from the contact's structured name fields, not a guess, and a birthday with no year set (vCard's own way of expressing that) is kept as unknown rather than invented. The next steps let you review and correct everything (and swap first/last name for everyone at once) before anything is imported.

import_vcard_other_dates.title: Import other dates from vCard
import_vcard_other_dates.description: Upload a .vcf file. Reads every date other than the birthday: the standard "Anniversary" field, plus any custom-labelled date your contacts app lets you add per contact (e.g. "Anniversary", "Other", or a label you typed in yourself). Unlike birthdays, these aren't all the same kind of event - the next steps let you review each one, with its detected label shown for context, and assign it the right event type individually.

import_options.title: Import from {source_label} - settings
import_options.description: These apply to every entry found in the file. You'll get a chance to review and edit individual entries next.

data.swap_names: Swap first/last name for all entries
data.use_description_year: Use the year found in each entry's description instead of its start date, where one is found (e.g. "geb. 1985")

import_review.title: Import from {source_label} - review ({page}/{total_pages})
import_review.description:
{legend}

Check the proposed first/last name split below and correct anything that's wrong - the birthday itself is editable too - or uncheck an entry to leave it out entirely. A possible duplicate is flagged with its existing entry's name; leave "create as new" unchecked to update that entry instead of adding a second one. Field labels here are shown in English only, regardless of your language setting.

remove_ics_imports.title: Remove ICS-imported events
remove_ics_imports.description: {count} event(s) were created by a previous ICS import. Click OK to remove all of them - entries an ICS import only updated (rather than created) are never affected, nor are manually added, CSV-, or vCard-imported events.

remove_vcard_imports.title: Remove vCard-imported events
remove_vcard_imports.description: {count} event(s) were created by a previous vCard import. Click OK to remove all of them - entries a vCard import only updated (rather than created) are never affected, nor are manually added, CSV-, or ICS-imported events.

import_events.title: Import events
import_events.description: Pick a source to import from.

remove_events.title: Remove events
remove_events.description: Pick which previously imported events to remove.

import_holidays.title: Import holidays
import_holidays.description: Pick a country to import its holidays as events. Re-running this later for the same country (and subdivision) updates the existing entries instead of creating duplicates - safe to repeat if a country adds a new holiday.

import_holidays_options.title: Import holidays - {country}
import_holidays_options.description: Leave the subdivision empty for national holidays only - a state/province adds its own regional holidays on top. Categories and language depend on what this country's holiday data provides. Multi-day categories like school holidays are represented as one event on their first day.

data_description.include_observed: This country's holidays are sometimes shifted to a nearby weekday when they fall on a weekend (e.g. observed the Friday before or Monday after) - import that shifted date too, as a separate event.

remove_holidays.title: Remove imported holidays
remove_holidays.description: {total} holiday event(s) currently imported. Check the box below to remove all of them, or leave it unchecked and pick one batch instead. Manually added events are never affected.

annual_settings.title: Annual Settings
annual_settings.description: Comma-separated occurrence numbers that get an event automatically marked "Important" for that event type, e.g. "18,21,30,40,50". Leave a field empty to disable this for that type.

delete_all.title: Delete all Annuals data
delete_all.description: This permanently deletes all {count} event(s), the shared calendars, and the Annuals hub itself - the entire integration and everything it created. This cannot be undone. Click OK to confirm.
